yummyinmytumbly:

CUCUMBER HERB-INFUSED WATER


What You Need
½ cucumber
1 lemon
2 sprigs rosemary
One handful thyme
One handful mint

What To Do
Wash and thinly slice one lemon and ½ cucumber.
Fill a pitcher with water. Add lemon slices, cucumber slices, and herbs.
Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.
